observation.description: Experience reliable and efficient computing with the Kaqika OptiPlex 7400 All-In-One desktop, a professionally refurbished unit engineered to meet the demands of modern work environments. Equipped with the powerful Intel Core i7-12700 (12th Gen) processor, this all-in-one system features 12 cores operating at a base clock speed of 2.1GHz, delivering robust multitasking capabilities and consistent performance. Complemented by 16GB of DDR4 memory and a 256GB solid-state drive, it ensures swift data access and smooth operation of business applications. Pre-installed with Windows 11 Pro, this renewed Kaqika desktop provides enhanced security features and a user-centric interface tailored for professional use. Supported by a comprehensive 1-year warranty covering parts and labor, the OptiPlex 7400 offers a dependable computing solution suitable for corporate offices, educational institutions, and home offices alike.
